verdict: NO_PUBLIC_WIDGET — do not build on this

keyProps.TemporalSupportedObjectLookup: Empty interface intended for module augmentation by an adapter, e.g. `declare module '@base-ui/react/internals/temporal' { interface TemporalSupportedObjectLookup { 'date-fns': Date } }`; TemporalSupportedObject resolves to the registered date-object union (or `any` when nothing is registered).
keyProps.TemporalValue / TemporalRangeValue / Tem: value/defaultValue type for non-range date-time components / range components ([start, end]) / either
keyProps.TemporalAdapterDateFns: The only adapter implementation actually exported in this version (index.d.ts re-exports TemporalAdapterDateFns); a Luxon subpath exists but the date-fns adapter is the shipped one.

controlled: Types only: TemporalValue/TemporalRangeValue describe the value/defaultValue pair that the unshipped components were designed to accept.
notableDifferences: These subpaths are scaffolding for date/time components that are NOT exported in 1.8.0. The type comments reference 'date, time and date-time components' and 'date-range, time-range and date-time-range components' — none of which has a public component subpath. No file in the published bundle imports the adapters, so the types are inert.

`date-fns@^4.0.0` and `@date-fns/tz@^1.2.0` are optional peerDependencies (so the package installs without them) and neither is installed in this repo; a future migration to Base UI date components would additionally require adding date-fns (and possibly @date-fns/tz). The repo currently standardises on @internationalized/date 3.12.3, which this scaffolding does not accept.
Treat any date API here as unstable/undocumented: it is not in the docs index and not covered by the public API surface.
